    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbandonedShip
    Class that manages the single card abandoned ship In order of position, starting from the leader, the trucker decides, checking the crew members requirement, if he/she wants to lose members of the crew and days of flight in exchange for cosmic credits.

    Class that manages the single card abandoned ship In order of position, starting from the leader, the trucker decides, checking the crew members requirement, if he/she wants to lose days of flight in exchange for goods.
